title: Booking through ABC and Joe Glazer; Godfrey's love of Dixieland
summary: Liberto's band was booked by ABC under Joe Glazer; the reel runs out as they mention Mintz and McGarrity and Godfrey's taste for Dixieland.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: That Gene Traxler was playing up on a contemporary hotel roof with the big Don Lamont band. And I was back home before I found out about that. And he was a marvelous bass player. And I think Roy LaBord and I met Don Lamont one day in Joe Glazer's office when we were up there on business to see Joe Glazer in New York. And I remember that the LaBord and the band used to be booked by ABC, which is an associated book and corporation, which at the time the late Joe Glazer was in charge.
The real is about to run out, but I remember just to mention Johnny Mintz and Lou McGarrity being in the band with a...
Right. Right. Oh, they had a very fine group.
Godfrey loves Dixieland music. He just loves it. Mm-hm.
